title: GET /Account/v1/User/{UUID} response
description: Response shape for the user-detail endpoint, used by BookStoreApiTest Test 7 (getUserDetails_ShouldIncludeAddedBook). NOTE the casing: this endpoint's id field is 'userId' (lowercase d), while POST /Account/v1/User's creation response (see account-created.json) uses 'userID' (capital D) for what is otherwise the same value — a real, documented inconsistency in DemoQA's own API, not a typo in this schema. This is exactly the kind of thing schema validation is meant to catch if it were ever silently 'fixed' (or broken further) server-side: the field-by-field Hamcrest assertions in the test only check 'username' and 'books.isbn' today and would not notice a change to this field's name or casing.
